mapper.select: SELECT gs.sample_id AS sampleId, gs.tenant_id AS tenantId, gs.patient_id AS patientId, '' AS patientName, gs.sample_no AS sampleNo, gs.sample_type AS sampleType, gs.panel_id AS panelId, gp.name AS panelName, gs.status, gs.received_date AS receivedDate, gs.completed_date AS completedDate, gs.note, gs.created_by AS createdBy, '' AS createdByName, gs.created_at AS createdAt, gs.updated_at AS updatedAt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM variants v WHERE v.sample_id = gs.sample_id) AS variantCount FROM genomic_samples gs LEFT JOIN gene_panels gp ON gp.panel_id = gs.panel_id WHERE gs.sample_id = #{sampleId} AND gs.tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT 'GS-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD((COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(sample_no FROM 9) AS INT)) FROM genomic_samples WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND sample_no LIKE 'GS-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-%'), 0) + 1)::TEXT, 4, '0')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO genomic_samples (tenant_id, patient_id, sample_no, sample_type, panel_id, note, created_by) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{patientId}, (SELECT 'GS-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-' || LPAD((COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(s.sample_no FROM 9) AS INT)) FROM genomic_samples s WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND s.sample_no LIKE 'GS-' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYY') || '-%'), 0) + 1)::TEXT, 4, '0')), #{sampleType}, #{panelId}, #{note}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE genomic_samples SET sample_type = #{sampleType}, panel_id = #{panelId}, note = #{note}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE sample_id = #{sampleId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM genomic_samples WHERE sample_id = #{sampleId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
